manifest.purpose: Hardened C++ file, must compile standalone (with harness-provided TRACE_ACCESS macro defaulting to no-op if undefined). Declares `static const uint8_t table[16]` (arbitrary fixed distinct byte values, unchanged in spirit from original) and defines `uint8_t lookup(uint8_t value, uint8_t key)` with the exact pinned signature. Implementation: compute `uint8_t idx = (value ^ key) & 0x0F;` then a single `for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) { TRACE_ACCESS(i); uint8_t mask = -(uint8_t)(i == idx); result |= table[i] & mask; }` using ascending fixed loop 0..15, no data-dependent branches, no early exit, accumulating into `uint8_t result = 0` via bitwise OR masking so exactly 16 reads always occur in order 0..15 regardless of value/key, and return result. Satisfies FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR4: identical trace every call, exactly 16 TRACE_ACCESS calls, output equals table[(value^key)&0x0F] for all 65536 pairs, no STL/heap/recursion, compiles clean under g++ -O0/-O2.
